articles.title: WHO warns ‘more complex’ Ebola outbreak now present in 3 African countries - Al Jazeera
articles.description: Health officials are investigating where Nigeria’s first patient, confirmed this week, was infected.
articles.content: The World Health Organization (WHO) says the Ebola outbreak that emerged in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is growing more complex, with cases now present in countries in East and West Africa… [+3262 chars]
